title: "How to teach programming (and other things)?" by Felienne Hermans
summary: Felienne Hermans's Strange Loop keynote on the history and pedagogy of teaching programming. She questions exploration-only approaches like Logo and discusses research supporting explicit instruction and rote practice.
why: Cited in threads about teaching kids and beginners to code as research-based evidence that explicit instruction beats pure discovery.

quote.text: The talk is on YouTube and I gotta say, it's very insightful.
